title: One Space cannot block another from setting up email on a domain it does not own

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), Space email review of #3365 (EMAIL-012).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: space_email_domain_operations.domain is globally unique and prepareEmailDomainSetup inserts the operation before any TXT ownership proof, while spaces.domain is saved without proof. A paid Space can connect victim.com, prepare email and release the site domain; the real owner then always gets 'This domain is already being connected'. THE FIX: make the constraint unique(space_id, domain), or let an expired pending operation with no provider id be taken over; global uniqueness then rests on space_email_domains, written only after the TXT proof. Needs a migration.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!fs.readdirSync('supabase/migrations').some(f=>f>'20270346007800'&&/space_email_domain_operations/.test(r('supabase/migrations/'+f))&&/unique\s*\(\s*space_id\s*,\s*domain\s*\)|drop constraint/i.test(r('supabase/migrations/'+f)))){console.error('SCAN-830: an unproven email domain operation still holds the domain for every Space');process.exit(1)}"
